post.title: Money resolutions don't fail from willpower. Here's proof
post.ig:
Your money resolution isn't a willpower problem. It's a setup problem.
Fidelity: the top money resolution for 2026 was saving more (44%).
Vanguard, 2025: 94% of workers joined 401(k) plans that enrolled them automatically, vs 64% in opt-in plans. 61% of Vanguard plans auto-enrolled by 2025, up from 48% in 2018.
A 2004 Save More Tomorrow study: savings rates rose from 3.5% to 13.6% in 40 months when workers pre-committed future raises.
Our math: $50 automatic transfer x 26 paychecks = $1,300 a year.
Sources: Fidelity (Dec 2025), Vanguard How America Saves, Thaler and Benartzi (2004).
News and education, not financial advice.
